svg.title: Rabbit
svg.desc: Seated white laboratory rabbit with long pinnae, powerful hindlimbs, compact forelimbs, red-pink eye, and short tail. Biological basis: Rabbits are used in antibody production, ophthalmology, cardiovascular research, and surgical training because of their size and accessible vasculature and ocular anatomy.
